text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Geez, why is this happeningーー?!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Wait, isn't the signal here way too bad?!
At this rate—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"At this rate, I... I won't make it in time...
Even though I've waited all this time, not like this...!"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ngh...!
If that's how it is, we'll just find a spot with good reception!
You help out too!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Judging by how distressed she looks,
she might be waiting for an important message.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"In an open area like this,
the signal should reach just fine—"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Aah! No good, nothing's changing!!
How about you?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Ah, geez! You clunky signal receiver! Next!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! Indeed!
If the signal is too far, getting closer should surely—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Off the board--!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Why?! We're closer to the satellite than we were a moment ago, aren't we?!
choice_data_list: Cell phone signals have nothing to do with satellites, you know...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Huh!? Isn't it being transmitted from a satellite!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I explained that radio waves are transmitted
via base station antennas...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Why didn't you say that sooner?! Where's the antenna?
Even if it's in the next town over, I'll go!"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Ah... The signal...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We searched all over for cell service after that,
but just couldn't seem to find any.
choice_data_list: (Is there anywhere else with good reception—)

text_block_list.name: Beach Hut Customer A
text_block_list.text: Doesn't this mega-portion yakisoba look totally photogenic?

text_block_list.name: Beach Hut Customer B
text_block_list.text:
Sounds good! Let's take a video of you eating
and send it to everyone!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Cell service strong enough to send video...
Could that beach shack have—"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... Talk about missing what's right under your nose.
To think that shop had Wi-Fi all along.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Yet, with this, at long last…… at long last……

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Finally, I can watch my drama!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Yes! Today's the release day for the latest chapter of *Court & Noble*!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"In today's episode, the heroine stands in the courtroom for the first time!
After endless preparations, she finally reaches the decisive moment!"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"It'd totally ruin the mood if the video buffered halfway through, right?
I'm so glad I downloaded it!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...To think she ran all over mountains and seas just to download an overseas drama.
Still, seeing how happy she looked was rather endearing—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, what? What are you grinning at?
choice_data_list: No, I just realized how much you must love that drama.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
!! ...J-Just so you know!
It's not like I was desperate just because I like you!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: It's not for childish reasons like that! I mean, so... what I'm saying is—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: It's practically a mission of mine!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
A first-rate lady must always stay
sensitive to current trends!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Especially if it's an overseas TV drama
that's all the rage among celebrities worldwide!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Besides, since I was already watching it,
I was curious to see how it continued...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
It always ends right at the best part.
I wonder what happened after that...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
King Halo desperately wants to watch overseas TV dramas.
In that case—
choice_data_list: You can watch your drama when we get back.
You can watch your drama when we get back.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
King Halo desperately wants to watch overseas TV dramas.
In that case—
choice_data_list: You can watch your drama when we get back.
You can watch your drama when we get back.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
You don't have to tell me, of course that's the plan!
You'd better hurry up and—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...Ah.
Um... well, how should I put it?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Today's success is thanks to your efforts.
This King will generously grant you praise!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Savor this joy, and get plenty of rest!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: With that, she happily returned to her room.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
………………Yes, of course!
It's only one episode, so it'll be fine!
Besides—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
As a first-rate lady, why would I ever
get distracted by anything other than what I've chosen to watch?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
King Halo seemed completely confident
in her ability not to stay up late.
